title: Registered repeat renderer example
summary: Core repeat component and module configuration from the official example, with Bootstrap presentation excluded from Material guarantees.

facts.claim: The official repeater example registers repeat to RepeatTypeComponent, which extends FieldArrayType, renders field.fieldGroup with formly-field, and wires buttons to add() and remove(i). Its field configuration supplies the fieldArray item template; repeat is an example-defined registered name.
conditions: For the official string alias type: repeat configuration, use the example component together with its type registration and fieldArray configuration.
limits: The example imports FormlyBootstrapModule and uses Bootstrap layout/button classes; replace presentation for Material and verify the target stack.
This is a core array mechanism example, not a compiled, browser-tested or turnkey Material recipe.
General custom type registration is covered by existing facts; the repeat name is not universally supplied by core.
This alias-specific example does not require string registration when using a component class directly as type.
facts.context: RepeatTypeComponent, FieldArrayType renderer, repeat registration, fieldArray input template, add/remove UI and Bootstrap-to-Material adaptation boundary.

## E01

**Repeatable section.** [Fields](sources.md#e01a), [module registration](sources.md#e01b), [repeat type](sources.md#e01c).

Shows a registered `repeat` type extending `FieldArrayType`, a `fieldArray` template, and add/remove controls. `repeat` is an example's registered name, not an assumed core built-in. Transfer the model/array mechanism; replace Bootstrap-specific presentation with the consuming Material design. Check insertion, deletion, defaults, validation, and hide/show behavior. See [arrays](arrays.md).
